g.text: Where odorants come from, at finer taxonomic ranks

text.style: fill: #8a8a86; font: italic 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Mammalian taxa are excluded: they appear as sources because a compound was measured in milk, breath or body odour, not synthesised there.
